text:
Type: wooden dining armchair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, Japandi
Materials: solid beech frame, woven paper cord rattan seat
Colors: light natural wood, pale beige seat
Shape: curved panel back rail, straight flat arms on round posts, woven seat, round tapered legs with stretchers, light and open
Feel: airy, calm, crafted
Goes with: light oak tables, white walls, linen textiles; Scandinavian or Japandi rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mid-Century Beech and Rattan Dining Chair with Arms, 21.9"W, Natural
product.description: This simple, well-crafted chair, made of solid beech, is light and casual, evoking the simplicity of mid-century design. Its sturdy craftsmanship will make it last, while its soft, woven seat will keep it a joy to sit in. 21.9"W x 19.5"D x 30"H Beech legs and arms with a woven paper-rope seat This chair is light, breezy, and simple to move and fit in any room in the house. Its handwoven seat is attractive and easy to sink into. This chair's natural mid-century look ensures it will work with different decors. No assembly required Using a soft, damp cloth, wipe in the direction of the grain. Free returns for 30 days; 3-year warranty.
